description:
Get price at a point in time. Returns the last known price for an asset at or before the given timestamp.
Use this to value a position, settle a trade, or anchor a calculation to a
specific moment in time.

asset_class.description: Asset class to resolve the symbol in. Defaults to `spot` (one of: spot, perp)

asset_id.description: Backend asset ID. Mutually exclusive with `symbol`: exactly one of the two is required, and naming both is a 400.

timestamp.description: Unix timestamp in seconds. The response returns the most recent price at or before this moment.

name: get_price_at_time
